oncall-bot: INCIDENT 3924681000 — Routing anomalies detected: sudden variant hot-spot + regional failover churn. Auto-pager: paging @tyler-oncall and creating this incident thread :rotating_light:

oncall-bot: Summary metrics: 12% of requests got 5xx over last 3m, tail latency spiked from 120ms -> 2.4s, error budget at 78%. Detected fanout to variant 'v-lite-1' in us-east-1 and frequent fallback to eu-west-1.

alex.w: seeing the same in dashboard. routing-rule-eval counts show a huge increase in `fallback:region` hits after the 03:00 deploy. Lots of small instances behind v-lite-1 filling up.

maria.k: suspects the config-schema change we rolled at 02:45 that removed `legacy_default_fallback` handling. Validator accepted legacy docs but dropped that implicit value. Basically the old behaviour was `fallback: model` but now missing field => runtime picks regional fallback.

alex.w: logs excerpt: ```
2026-03-15T03:12:01Z router INFO route_eval user=prod svc=api route_id=abc123 result=fallback_region to=eu-west-1 variant=v-lite-1
2026-03-15T03:12:02Z runtime WARN kv-cache miss variant=v-lite-1 slots=0
2026-03-15T03:12:05Z infra ERROR send_request target=eu-west-1 status=502
```

tyler-oncall: paging now. I'm on my phone en route. Priority: contain customer impact and stop oscillation.

jess: which customers are impacted? product-ops, can we surface a list?

product-ops: quick query shows top affected: Searchly (12% of their requests failing), internal QA harness (flaky), and several small tenants on dedicated routing rules.

alex.w: immediate mitigation plan I propose: 1) disable the new schema migration flag (roll back validator) -> prevent new manifests from being interpreted; 2) add emergency routing override that pins heavy traffic to stable variants (v-stable-1/v-stable-2) for affected routes; 3) throttle fallbacks by adding `max_fallback_rate: 5%` to the routing controller until config is fixed.

maria.k: agreed. Also create quick compatibility shim in runtime to treat missing fallback as `model` while we audit manifests. Patch would be: ```diff
- if (manifest.fallback == undefined) { /* new behaviour: region */ }
+ if (manifest.fallback == undefined) { manifest.fallback = 'model' /* legacy */ }
```

sre-bot: NOTE: canary rollback of schema-validator queued — deploy job #deploy/49877. Expected ~3m to gate. @tyler-oncall please confirm.

tyler-oncall: confirm. Trigger the rollback now. Also I'm adding an emergency route override: `rule: override-pin` applied to `/api/v2/generate` for Searchly and 5 other tenants.

alex.w: applying override via admin API: ```bash
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood/api/overrides -d '{"route":"/api/v2/generate","pin_variants":["v-stable-1","v-stable-2"],"reason":"emergency pin after routing schema regression"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'
```

oncall-bot: Override deployed at 03:19:23Z. Metrics show initial reduction of 5xx for Searchly from 12% -> 3% within 90s.

maria.k: rolling runtime shim patch now (hotfix): patch id runtime/2199. Deploying to us-east-1 and eu-west-1 only to avoid wider risk.

jess: heading to the incident room to coordinate external comms. I'll draft a short note: "We detected routing policy regression after a config schema change leading to unexpected regional fallback. We’ve applied emergency overrides and rolled back the validator; working on full audit and patch. No PII exposed. Some customers experienced transient 5xx; we are investigating post-incident compensation where appropriate."

tyler-oncall: handoff: I'll be on until 04:00 UTC. @jess can take follow-up on postmortem and customer comms. Assigning to @maria.k for root cause and config audit; @alex.w to verify runtime metrics stabilise.

eng-runtime: observed failover loop signature: when fallback target saturates, health checks cause quick re-eval back to origin which then triggers fallback again — ~30s oscillation. We're adding a backoff window to prevent immediate re-fallbacks: `fallback_backoff_ms=600000` (10m) as a temporary guard.

alex.w: after override + rollback + shim + backoff, system metrics: 5xx -> 1.2%, p95 latency down to 220ms, fallback-churn down from 15/min -> 0.5/min. Looks stabilised.

product-ops: confirmed Searchly now reporting normal call success rate. QA harness still showing some historical failures; we'll replay their traffic through the pinned variants to compare outputs.

maria.k: next steps for RCA/doc: - audit all manifests created in the last 48h for missing `fallback` field - add schema validator test that enforces explicit fallback or default compatibility - change release checklist to include runtime + config migration integration test - prepare a KB article on deprecation migration path for customers

jess: I'll prepare customer-facing timeline and a short status update to affected tenants. Postmortem channel: please collect anchor tickets/commits and we’ll sync tomorrow 09:30 UTC.

tyler-oncall: I'm closing the immediate pager. If any oscillation reappears, re-ping this thread and I'll re-open. Great job everyone. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: INCIDENT 3924681000 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Pager closed at 03:45:05Z.

alex.w: saving logs and snippets to /incident/3924681000/artifacts. Will attach perf graphs + before/after routing maps.

maria.k: opening postmortem draft: `/docs/incidents/3924681000-routing-compatibility-postmortem.md` — will add timeline and RCA.

jess: note for postmortem: consider outreach to top-5 customers for SLO credit.

oncall-bot: participants: oncall-bot, alex.w, maria.k, tyler-oncall, jess, sre-bot, product-ops, eng-runtime. Thread closed.
